title: How can I reduce OTA commissions?
content: OTA commissions can significantly impact profitability and limit direct relationships with your guests. The most effective way to reduce dependence on third-party platforms is to create a booking experience that travelers trust and prefer to use directly. This includes providing clear information, showcasing your unique experiences, improving website usability, and removing friction from the booking process. When guests can easily find answers, compare options, and book with confidence, more bookings happen directly through your website.

title: Do I need a direct booking system if I already use an OTA?
content: Yes. OTAs help you get visibility, but direct booking systems give you control, higher margins, and direct relationships with your guests. When your website makes it easy to understand your experiences and complete a booking, more high-intent travelers naturally shift away from OTAs to direct reservations.

title: Can WhatsApp increase tour inquiries and bookings?
content: Yes. WhatsApp can significantly increase inquiries and booking, when combined with a well-structured website and clear booking flow, WhatsApp becomes a powerful conversion channel for turning interest into confirmed reservations.

title: How long does it take to improve Google rankings?
content: SEO is a gradual process. Eco-tourism websites can see early improvements within weeks, but stronger, stable rankings usually take a few months of consistent optimization and content improvement.

title: What makes WuvaTM different from a traditional web design agency?
content: Most web design agencies focus on building websites. WuvaTM focuses on increasing direct bookings. We combine website design, SEO, and booking system optimization to improve the entire guest journey from discovery to reservation for eco-tourism businesses.
